text: The constructible universe L (Gödel) is defined by transfinite recursion: L₀=∅, Lα+1 = the set of subsets of Lα definable by a first-order formula. Gödel showed:
choices: L is a proper class and a model of ZFC + GCH + AC
explanation: Gödel (1938): L is an inner model of ZFC+AC+GCH. In L, the Axiom of Choice and Generalised Continuum Hypothesis hold. This shows ZFC+AC+GCH is consistent if ZFC is.
